name: Zhu Xin
bio: Zhu was born in 1996 and graduated from China Academy of Art. His short film, Community was awarded the Innovative Award at Jimei Amphibia Youth Film Festival. His first feature film, Vanishing Days, was made with a super low budget when he was in college.

credits.title: Cleo
credits.overview: Director Mark finds producer Li Dan, hoping to film his screenplay "Cleo." The ship in the script sails against the current, but everyone has vanished. As Li Dan questions him, Mark says the ship has a sole survivor...

credits.title: All Quiet at Sunrise
credits.overview: Ma Ke immerses himself in his graduate dissertation on Lucy, the Australopithecus known as “grandmother of mankind”. After his mother inadvertently brings him to a remote house, he seems to discover a pathway to decode human language and regain the essence of love.

credits.title: A Song River
credits.overview: To find the hometown in his memories, Zhu Xin tries to restore a Song Dynasty poem from a millennia ago, setting off a journey across time and space.

credits.title: Zoom In, Zoom Out
credits.overview: Shi, a young game designer, embarks on a difficult journey across the city to look for his missing roommate Gao. Following a clue hidden in an online game, he unexpectedly meets YY, Gao's girlfriend. credits.title: Coo Coo Quark Quark
credits.overview: A group of young people born in or after 1995 from Hangzhou set out on a quest for a cherished item they lost in their childhood, a journey that unexpectedly changed their lives in the process.

credits.title: Vanishing Days
credits.overview: A muggy summer of 2009, reality and memory tangled together, water from the canal soaked everyone in those vanishing days.

credits.title: Olympic
credits.overview: In 2064, the human body no longer has secrets. The world record for the men’s 100-meter dash set by Jamaican athlete Powell more than fifty years ago remains unbroken.  Twenty-three-year-old athlete Mara is preparing for the next Olympics until a gunshot shatters the highway order like a curse.

credits.title: fragile women
credits.overview: At a picnic in the countryside, the woman accidentally strikes a shuttlecock into water. The man leaps into the river and then I hear the mountain wind.

credits.overview: On that afternoon, an old man quarrels with the driver on a bus that runs between the old town and the new.
